name: gizza-ai/images-to-animated-webp
summary: Combine images into an animated WebP

tool.description: Combine a set of images into a single animated WebP (lossless VP8L), one frame per image in order — usually much smaller than the equivalent GIF and with 24-bit color plus real alpha instead of GIF's 256-color palette. delay_ms sets the per-frame delay (10-60000, default 200); frame_delays_ms overrides it per image. loop_count 0 loops forever. order can replay the frames reverse or boomerang. Frames are placed on a common canvas (the max width/height, optionally scaled down by max_width) using fit=contain|cover|stretch, padded with the background color ('transparent' supported). colors=2-256 palette-quantizes each frame for much smaller files. Provide images as a list, each a url or a `ref` (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP).

background.description: Background color as #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, or 'transparent' (default #ffffff). Fills the padding when frames differ in size.

colors.description: Reduce every frame to this many colors before encoding (2-256), which shrinks the file a lot for flat-color/graphic frames. 0 = keep full color (default).

delay_ms.description: Delay shown for every frame, in milliseconds (10-60000, default 200 = 5 fps). Ignored for a frame that has its own value in frame_delays_ms.

fit.description: How images that don't match the canvas aspect ratio are placed: 'contain' (default, fit inside and pad with the background), 'cover' (fill and center-crop), or 'stretch' (distort to the exact canvas size).

frame_delays_ms.description: Optional per-image delays in milliseconds, comma separated, one per image in the order supplied (e.g. '100,100,800' to hold the last frame). Empty = use delay_ms for every frame.

images.description: Ordered list of image sources (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP) to animate, one per frame. Each item has exactly one of `url` or `ref`.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

loop_count.description: How many times the animation plays: 0 = loop forever (default), 1 = play once, 3 = play three times.

max_width.description: Scale the canvas down to this width in pixels, keeping the aspect ratio (0 = keep the natural size). Never scales up.

order.description: Playback order of the images: 'forward' (default), 'reverse', or 'boomerang' (forward then back, ping-pong, without repeating the end frames).
